category: Convolution (1D, dense) + bias + requant via matrix engine
edge_cases: dense cross-channel 1D conv (VALID) lowered to a OL x K x C_out matmul, K = C_in*Kw = 80
im2col gathers each output position's C_in*Kw window into a crouton row
reduction K=80 zero-padded to 3 crouton K-tiles; division-free pack (koff/poff)
im2col activation packed once per M-tile and REUSED across N-tiles (amortizes im2col)
HMX native output r = sign-extend of the 12-bit 0x40 requant field
per-channel int32 bias then saturating int8 requant fused into the HVX epilogue
edge biases force -128 / +127 saturation and no-bias passthrough
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
name: i8_conv1d_bias_requant_hmx
